sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Clone app
Installs TeraBox as a separate app alongside the original, with its own account. Each copy needs a different clone number.
Fix Google login
Restores signing in with a Google account.
Fix transfers over VPN
Runs uploads, downloads and saves from shared links while a VPN is active.
Hide ads
Removes feed, banner and video ads, plus interstitial and app-open ads. Rewarded ads still play when requested from Benefits.
Hide consent form
Hides the ad consent form shown at startup.
Hide home shortcuts
Removes Trending and Short Drama from Home and More, and Translate where it appears. Options hide the Creative Generation tools, Signature, PDF Encryption and Add Watermark too.
Hide promotions
Removes Premium and sale offers, plus prize and campaign cards, speed-up prompts, floating invites and coupon popups.
Hide video recommendations
Removes recommendations below the player.
Remove recent panel
Removes Recent, Starred and Offline from Home.
Show backup count
Shows remaining files on Home and Photos, including paused backups.
Unlock Premium Plus
Unlocks HD, 3x speed and uploads, with HD up to original quality. HD buffers faster over parallel connections.
